assets.name: The Warrens

Use case: stylized-concept. Production 2D top-down FLOOR TEXTURE sheet for a gritty painted pixel-art insect hive game. Input image is STYLE reference only for restrained textured painterly pixel finish. This is NOT a scene or a presentation board. Exactly 4 columns by 2 rows of equal SQUARE tiles, 2:1 canvas ideally 2048x1024. Every cell completely filled to its edges with opaque floor texture. No margins, no labels, no grid lines, no objects, no walls, no shadows, no gradients, no border, no vignette, no characters. Lighting uniformly diffuse straight overhead. All eight textures are subdued middle-dark value, low contrast, subtle fine grain, few small cracks; no busy large-scale motifs, so enemies remain readable. Each tile is independently seamless and tileable on both axes. In each tile all edges have the same typical material distribution as the middle.
Top row left to right:
1 Warrens: grey-brown compacted silt with fine earth grain, sparse dark dried resin hairline seams, no orange glow.
2 Granary: desaturated grey-olive packed earth with tiny low fungal fibers, faint worn patches, no mushroom objects.
3 Paper Hive: grey-tan pressed paper pulp and fine straw fibers, subtle organic hexagonal wear impressions, no bold honeycomb grid.
4 Boiling Galleries: cool charcoal-grey basalt grit and ash with small worn dull brown flakes, hairline fissures, no lava.
Bottom row left to right:
5 Lantern Deep: dark cold slate-grey limestone dust and sparse fine silk fibers, no glowing details.
6 Rot Cellar: muted olive-grey wet sediment with restrained dark stains and very small moisture highlights, no bright puddles.
7 Royal Cell: smoky mauve-grey compacted mineral/resin dust with sparse dark purple seams, no glow or gold.
8 Breach: cool grey-brown reservoir silt, faint small dried mud cracks and grit, no obvious stones or objects.
Use the reference's grounded dark outlined painted illustration finish at texture scale, never photorealistic or smooth plastic. Floors must be MUCH quieter and less saturated than wall plates.
